./ROADMAP.md:3:> 最后更新: 2026-05-31 15:53 UTC | 更新原因: 量化 H1/exp_002 判据并新增 H2 partial-pooling claim
./ROADMAP.md:9:核心问题：当 LLM 注释误分类率在 subgroup 间不同，并且误分类强度与真实 CATE/HTE 结构相关时，使用单一全局 confusion matrix 的纠偏可能放大 subgroup CATE bias，甚至比不纠偏更差。
./ROADMAP.md:13:H1: 在 misclassification rate 与真实 subgroup CATE magnitude 正相关的 DGP 中，全局 confusion-matrix correction 会 under-correct 高误差/高效应 subgroup，并 over-correct 低误差/低效应 subgroup，因此 GATE RMSE 可能高于 uncorrected。
./ROADMAP.md:15:H2: subgroup-specific correction 能降低 H1 暴露的结构性偏差；当 expert label budget 较小时，partial pooling 会比 per-subgroup independent confusion matrix 更稳健。
./ROADMAP.md:17:H3: naive CI 会低估 Stage 1 misclassification estimation uncertainty；sandwich 或 bootstrap variance adjustment 能改善 subgroup CATE coverage。
./ROADMAP.md:25:H1 success for exp_001：在 positive-correlation high-misclassification/high-CATE-heterogeneity 设置中，`oracle_global - uncorrected` 的 GATE RMSE 差值大于 0，且 bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0。`estimated_global` 单独报告；`estimated_global - oracle_global` 用于量化 finite-sample confusion-estimation noise。如果 GATE RMSE 支持 H1 但 secondary bias diagnostics 方向相反，标记 mixed，先 Director 复核再推进 Stage 1。
./ROADMAP.md:27:H1 negative for exp_001：如果 positive-correlation worst-case 中 oracle global 不劣于 uncorrected，则 H1 暂不支持；下一步先审计 DGP construction、correction algebra、metric definitions、subgroup weighting，而不是推进 Stage 1。
./ROADMAP.md:29:`exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid`：primary metric 是 `global_worse_rate_difference_positive_minus_negative`；secondary metrics 是 `bias_bound_vs_global_worse_spearman` 与 `estimated_global_minus_oracle_global_gate_rmse`；每个 condition 最低 200 replications。
./ROADMAP.md:31:H1 success for exp_002：positive-correlation conditions 的 oracle-global-worse rate 至少比 negative-correlation controls 高 20 percentage points，且 bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0；bias-bound diagnostic 对 oracle-global-worse conditions 的 Spearman rho >= 0.50，且 bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0。estimated-global 结果必须与 oracle-global 分开报告。
./ROADMAP.md:37:1. 完成 `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp` CPU-only 半合成 MVP simulation，验证 H1。必跑对照为 uncorrected、oracle global confusion correction、estimated global confusion correction、stratified/subgroup correction；必须拆开结构性 global-correction 偏差与 finite-sample confusion-estimation noise。
./ROADMAP.md:38:2. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` 只能在 PENDING 审批、QUEUED、Director GPU allocation 后启动。GPU 实验必须使用项目白名单 `seetacloud-38274/root/cuda:0`，并在 spec 中记录 command、server、GPU 型号、driver、data_path/data_count、seed、disk estimate、expected runtime、log/checkpoint/artifact 路径。
./ROADMAP.md:39:3. 建立统一评测协议：GATE RMSE、subgroup CATE bias、PEHE、CI coverage、CI width、bound tightness。所有指标必须能追溯到 registry exp_id。
./ROADMAP.md:40:4. 维护 `experiment_plan.yaml` 与 experiment matrix 映射：H1 claim、H2 claim、Stage 0 DGP grid、Stage 1 correction ablation、real-data feasibility 均必须有 plan entry 和 target/cell 映射。

./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:42:Parameter construction differs materially. `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp` uses a deliberately skewed worst-case DGP: `tau_values=[0.0, 4.3, 5.4, 5.5]`、`error_rates=[0.02, 0.06, 0.29, 0.45]`、`group_probs=[0.59, 0.09, 0.14, 0.18]` from `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp`. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` uses uniform true subgroup sampling, CATE ranges centered near 0.5, misclassification ranges `low=[0.10,0.18]` and `high=[0.04,0.36]`, and `k in {3,6}` from `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid`. The exp001 single point creates severe prior-weighted posterior distortion; exp002 dilutes that into many regimes where uncorrected noise can already be close to the target or global correction acts like a shrinkage transform.
./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:44:Correction algebra differs and is the strongest mechanism-audit finding. `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp` constructs `posterior_true_given_noisy = P(G | Z)` using both confusion and subgroup prior, then solves `tau_Z = W tau_G` with a pseudo-inverse. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` computes `observed_gate` by noisy labels but then solves `transition.T * tau = observed_gate` directly. For subgroup-varying error rates, observed GATE by noisy label is a posterior-weighted estimand that requires normalization by noisy-label prevalence. Directly inverting `transition.T` is not algebraically equivalent to the exp001 posterior correction, except in special balanced cases. This can flip or mute the intended under/over-correction mechanism.
./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:46:Subgroup weighting differs. `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp` global confusion uses a group-probability-weighted pooled error, so high-effect minority groups can be over/under-corrected relative to a majority-driven pooled matrix. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` uses `z_true = torch.randint(0, k, ...)`, so subgroup priors are uniform in expectation and the global pooled error is an unweighted mean of subgroup error rates. That removes a large part of exp001's prior-weighted worst-case leverage.
./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:48:Metric aggregation differs. `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp` primary metric is paired mean `oracle_global_minus_uncorrected_gate_rmse` in one positive high/high DGP. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` primary metric is the difference of mean `oracle_global_worse_rate` between positive and negative condition sets. A condition can have a small positive mean RMSE delta but a high worse-rate, or a negative mean RMSE delta but a nonzero worse-rate. This makes exp002 a direction-discrimination test, not a direct repeat of exp001.
./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:50:Positive/negative correlation definition differs from the exp001 mechanism. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` defines direction by ranking `error_rates` against `abs(cate)`, but its `bias_bound_score` uses `abs(centered_rate * centered_cate)`, which discards sign. Therefore positive and negative directions can share the same or nearly same diagnostic score. This explains why `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` bias-bound Spearman can be negative even when local positive cells exist: the diagnostic measures magnitude coupling, not signed positive-vs-negative coupling.
./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:52:Oracle-vs-estimated split does not explain exp002 negative. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` estimated-vs-oracle gap is 0.0007658914546482265, while the primary failure is -0.004999995231628418 and the rank diagnostic is -0.6201611161231995. The exp002 failure is therefore not caused by estimated confusion matrix budget noise.
./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:54:The stratified subgroup comparator is also a warning sign. In `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp`, stratified correction has `gate_rmse=0.08234754252792217` versus uncorrected `gate_rmse=0.26032738576584474`. In `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid`, aggregated stratified-minus-uncorrected mean is positive for `misclassification_heterogeneity=high, cate_heterogeneity=high` at 0.03885 and positive for `misclassification_heterogeneity=high, cate_heterogeneity=low` at 0.07807. Since the stratified comparator uses the true subgroup transition but the same direct `transition.T` solve, this supports the algebra-mismatch explanation.
./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:58:H1a: If correction is implemented with a posterior-normalized operator `P(G | Z)` and the same subgroup-prior weighting as the estimand, then positive misclassification-CATE correlation will again separate from negative controls in the exp002 grid. This should be tested before interpreting the current exp002 negative as a substantive failure of the EC-HTE mechanism.
./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:60:H1b: The exp001 mechanism requires both signed positive error-CATE coupling and subgroup-prior imbalance. A balanced-prior grid may not show global correction worse than uncorrected unless the design explicitly varies group probabilities and reports prior-weighted posterior distortion.
./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:62:H1c: `bias_bound_score` should be signed or decomposed into signed correlation and magnitude terms. A magnitude-only diagnostic cannot distinguish positive and negative correlation controls and should not be the secondary success criterion for H1 directionality.
./artifacts/analysis/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:64:H1d: Stage1 correction ablations should remain blocked until the Stage0 correction operator is aligned. Otherwise partial pooling may be judged against an algebraically inconsistent "stratified" or "global" correction baseline.

./memory.md:4:EC-HTE 研究目标是纠正 LLM 生成的分类 effect modifier 中的差异性误分类对 CATE/HTE 估计造成的结构性偏差。首要可证伪机制是：当 subgroup misclassification rate 与真实 subgroup CATE magnitude 正相关时，单一全局 confusion-matrix correction 会系统性 under-correct 高误差/高效应 subgroup，并 over-correct 低误差/低效应 subgroup，因此可能比 uncorrected 更差。
./memory.md:13:- Honest causal forest: Wager & Athey (JASA 2018; arXiv:1510.04342, https://arxiv.org/abs/1510.04342; DOI page https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/01621459.2017.1319839) 给出用于 CATE/HTE 的 causal forest 和推断框架；honesty/sample splitting 是其核心推断条件。EC-HTE 的 causal-forest baseline 应固定 honesty 开启，并报告 CI coverage 与 CI width，避免只报点估计误差。
./memory.md:25:- StratPPI: Fisch et al., NeurIPS 2024（https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/c9fcd02e6445c7dfbad6986abee53d0d-Abstract-Conference.html；arXiv:2406.04291）通过 stratified sampling 缩窄 PPI CI，尤其当 autorater performance across conditional distributions varies。EC-HTE 可把 StratPPI 作为 ATE/population mean 的 stratified correction baseline，或作为 expert allocation 思路来源；不能把它当成 categorical modifier confusion-matrix correction，除非 correction estimand 明确改成每个 subgroup 的 gold-label estimand。
./memory.md:32:- Global confusion matrix correction: 从 expert validation subset 估计单一 `P(Z_hat | Z)` 或 inverse matrix，把所有 subgroup 共用同一 misclassification mechanism。来源对应 epidemiology 中 matrix / inverse matrix correction for misclassification；见 Lyles et al. extended matrix/inverse matrix method with internal validation data（PMC https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4382468/）。本项目必须报告当 subgroup-specific error differs 时 global correction 的 under/over-correction。
./memory.md:33:- Per-subgroup confusion matrix correction: 在每个 true or pilot-estimated subgroup g 内估计 `C_g = P(Z_hat | Z, g)`，再做 correction。该 baseline 是 EC-HTE 的 non-pooled comparator；高方差风险来自每组 expert labels 少。来源是同一 validation-data misclassification framework；partial pooling 是本项目新增稳定化层，不能把 independent per-subgroup correction 写成已有 EC-HTE 结果。
./memory.md:35:- SIMEX categorical approximation: Kuchenhoff, Mwalili & Lesaffre, Biometrics 2006（PubMed https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16542233/）把 SIMEX 扩展到 discrete covariate/response misclassification，通过 transition matrix Pi 增加误分类并外推到无误分类。EC-HTE 可实现为 categorical transition-matrix SIMEX + causal forest baseline；必须标记为近似 baseline，因为项目目标变量是 categorical effect modifier，而 classic SIMEX 更自然地服务 regression parameter correction。
./memory.md:42:- 每个 experiment/config/replication 输出：seed、N、k、B、misclassification severity、CATE values、misclassification-CATE correlation direction、method、PEHE、per-subgroup CATE bias、GATE RMSE、95% CI empirical coverage、mean/median CI width、bound diagnostic product、runtime、artifact path。指标来自项目 brief；PEHE/GATE 定义见上方领域参考。

./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:42:Parameter construction differs materially. `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp` uses a deliberately skewed worst-case DGP: `tau_values=[0.0, 4.3, 5.4, 5.5]`、`error_rates=[0.02, 0.06, 0.29, 0.45]`、`group_probs=[0.59, 0.09, 0.14, 0.18]` from `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp`. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` uses uniform true subgroup sampling, CATE ranges centered near 0.5, misclassification ranges `low=[0.10,0.18]` and `high=[0.04,0.36]`, and `k in {3,6}` from `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid`. The exp001 single point creates severe prior-weighted posterior distortion; exp002 dilutes that into many regimes where uncorrected noise can already be close to the target or global correction acts like a shrinkage transform.
./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:44:Correction algebra differs and is the strongest mechanism-audit finding. `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp` constructs `posterior_true_given_noisy = P(G | Z)` using both confusion and subgroup prior, then solves `tau_Z = W tau_G` with a pseudo-inverse. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` computes `observed_gate` by noisy labels but then solves `transition.T * tau = observed_gate` directly. For subgroup-varying error rates, observed GATE by noisy label is a posterior-weighted estimand that requires normalization by noisy-label prevalence. Directly inverting `transition.T` is not algebraically equivalent to the exp001 posterior correction, except in special balanced cases. This can flip or mute the intended under/over-correction mechanism.
./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:46:Subgroup weighting differs. `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp` global confusion uses a group-probability-weighted pooled error, so high-effect minority groups can be over/under-corrected relative to a majority-driven pooled matrix. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` uses `z_true = torch.randint(0, k, ...)`, so subgroup priors are uniform in expectation and the global pooled error is an unweighted mean of subgroup error rates. That removes a large part of exp001's prior-weighted worst-case leverage.
./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:48:Metric aggregation differs. `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp` primary metric is paired mean `oracle_global_minus_uncorrected_gate_rmse` in one positive high/high DGP. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` primary metric is the difference of mean `oracle_global_worse_rate` between positive and negative condition sets. A condition can have a small positive mean RMSE delta but a high worse-rate, or a negative mean RMSE delta but a nonzero worse-rate. This makes exp002 a direction-discrimination test, not a direct repeat of exp001.
./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:50:Positive/negative correlation definition differs from the exp001 mechanism. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` defines direction by ranking `error_rates` against `abs(cate)`, but its `bias_bound_score` uses `abs(centered_rate * centered_cate)`, which discards sign. Therefore positive and negative directions can share the same or nearly same diagnostic score. This explains why `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` bias-bound Spearman can be negative even when local positive cells exist: the diagnostic measures magnitude coupling, not signed positive-vs-negative coupling.
./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:52:Oracle-vs-estimated split does not explain exp002 negative. `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid` estimated-vs-oracle gap is 0.0007658914546482265, while the primary failure is -0.004999995231628418 and the rank diagnostic is -0.6201611161231995. The exp002 failure is therefore not caused by estimated confusion matrix budget noise.
./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:54:The stratified subgroup comparator is also a warning sign. In `exp_001_bias_bound_mvp`, stratified correction has `gate_rmse=0.08234754252792217` versus uncorrected `gate_rmse=0.26032738576584474`. In `exp_002_gpu_dgp_grid`, aggregated stratified-minus-uncorrected mean is positive for `misclassification_heterogeneity=high, cate_heterogeneity=high` at 0.03885 and positive for `misclassification_heterogeneity=high, cate_heterogeneity=low` at 0.07807. Since the stratified comparator uses the true subgroup transition but the same direct `transition.T` solve, this supports the algebra-mismatch explanation.
./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:58:H1a: If correction is implemented with a posterior-normalized operator `P(G | Z)` and the same subgroup-prior weighting as the estimand, then positive misclassification-CATE correlation will again separate from negative controls in the exp002 grid. This should be tested before interpreting the current exp002 negative as a substantive failure of the EC-HTE mechanism.
./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:60:H1b: The exp001 mechanism requires both signed positive error-CATE coupling and subgroup-prior imbalance. A balanced-prior grid may not show global correction worse than uncorrected unless the design explicitly varies group probabilities and reports prior-weighted posterior distortion.
./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:62:H1c: `bias_bound_score` should be signed or decomposed into signed correlation and magnitude terms. A magnitude-only diagnostic cannot distinguish positive and negative correlation controls and should not be the secondary success criterion for H1 directionality.
./artifacts/_project/report/exp002_negative_mechanism_audit_20260531.md:64:H1d: Stage1 correction ablations should remain blocked until the Stage0 correction operator is aligned. Otherwise partial pooling may be judged against an algebraically inconsistent "stratified" or "global" correction baseline.

estimands such as ATE。项目中的 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"arm-specific rectifier\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" baseline 应仅实现为 treatment/control arm 内各自估计 LLM-vs-expert residual/confusion correction，然后估计 ATE/GATE；它仍然是 arm-level/population-level rectification，不能代替 subgroup-specific modifier confusion correction。\\\\\\\\n- Ashwin real-data motivation: Ashwin, Chhabra & Rao, Sociological Methods & Research 2025, DOI 10.1177/00491241251338246（publisher page https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/00491241251338246；Maastricht record https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/using-large-language-models-for-qualitative-analysis-can-introduc-2/）用 Rohingya/Bengali host interviews 说明 LLM coding errors are not random with respect to respondent characteristics。World Bank summary explicitly names refugee status, gender, education as non-random error correlates（https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099348304162431121/pdf/IDU1271bc2541c5e8144f51b8cc1be231f985cc6.pdf）。本项目 real-data validation 只用于验证 differential misclassification pattern，不用于声称真实 CATE accuracy。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Measurement error / categorical misclassification correction baselines\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- Global confusion matrix correction: 从 expert validation subset 估计单一 `P(Z_hat | Z)` 或 inverse matrix，把所有 subgroup 共用同一 misclassification mechanism。来源对应 epidemiology 中 matrix / inverse matrix correction for misclassification；见 Lyles et al. extended matrix/inverse matrix method with internal validation data（PMC https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4382468/）。本项目必须报告当 subgroup-specific error differs 时 global correction 的 under/over-correction。\\\\\\\\n- Per-subgroup confusion matrix correction: 在每个 true or pilot-estimated subgroup g 内估计 `C_g = P(Z_hat | Z, g)`，再做 correction。该 baseline 是 EC-HTE 的 non-pooled comparator；高方差风险来自每组 expert labels 少。来源是同一 validation-data misclassification framework；partial pooling 是本项目新增稳定化层，不能把 independent per-subgroup correction 写成已有 EC-HTE 结果。\\\\\\\\n- Arm-specific correction: treatment/control arm 内分别估计 confusion/residual correction，模拟 Mozer/PPI arm-level rectifier 对 ATE 的处理。适用 ATE 或 arm-specific mean outcome/label correction；不能直接修正 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"which subgroup is the unit conditioned on\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" 的 modifier misclassification，除非同时对 subgroup-specific `C_{g,t}` 做建模。\\\\\\\\n- SIMEX categorical approximation: Kuchenhoff, Mwalili & Lesaffre, Biometrics 2006（PubMed https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16542233/）把 SIMEX 扩展到 discrete covariate/response misclassification，通过 transition matrix Pi 增加误分类并外推到无误分类。EC-HTE 可实现为 categorical transition-matrix SIMEX + causal forest baseline；必须标记为近似 baseline，因为项目目标变量是 categorical effect modifier，而 classic SIMEX 更自然地服务 regression parameter correction。\\\\\\\\n- Calibration/probability modifier baseline: 用 expert validation subset 做 Platt scaling / temperature scaling 或 Dirichlet/multinomial calibration，把 LLM hard label 改成 calibrated class probabilities，再作为 soft modifier features 输入 CATE estimator。该实现只校准 predicted probabilities；如果 downstream CATE 仍按 hard subgroup 分层，它不会消除 subgroup membership error。概率校准作为一般 ML practice 可参考 Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana, ICML 2005（https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1102351.1102430），但 EC-HTE 需在 artifact 中记录 calibration loss 和 subgroup confusion recovery，而非只报 predictive accuracy。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 首批实验协议\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### -lc \\\\\\\"sed -n '1,240p' docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md\\\\\\\"\\\",\\\"aggregated_output\\\":\\\"# EC-HTE Codex Scheme A\\\\n\\\\n## EC-HTE: Error-Corrected Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Estimation Under LLM Annotation Misclassification\\\\n\\\\n## Problem and Motivation\\\\n\\\\nWhen NLP researchers use LLM-generated annotations as effect modifiers in causal heterogeneous treatment effect (HTE) analysis, a previously unrecognized structural bias arises: LLM misclassification rates covary with the true conditional average treatment effect (CATE). Subgroups where LLMs err most in annotation (e.g., marginalized populations, linguistically complex cases) are often the same subgroups where treatment effects are largest. This creates a confounding between measurement error and causal heterogeneity that cannot be resolved by any global correction method—including arm-specific rectifiers (Mozer, arXiv:2603.19160), which address average treatment effect (ATE) bias but are algebraically incapable of correcting subgroup-level CATE distortions.\\\\n\\\\nThis problem is urgent. LLM-as-annotator has become the default pipeline for computational social science (Audinet de Pieuchon et al., EMNLP 2025, benchmarking DSL vs. PPI debiasing; StratPPI, Fisch et al., NeurIPS 2024, improving PPI via stratification), and researchers increasingly use LLM annotations not just for ATE estimation (where DSL and PPI provide corrections) but for subgroup analysis and effect modification—yet no correction method exists for this latter use case. Messing (arXiv:2604.11581) documents that hidden measurement error in LLM pipelines causes naive confidence intervals to under-cover by 40–60%, but this analysis remains at the aggregate level. Ashwin et al. (Sociological Methods & Research, 2025) provide direct empirical evidence that LLM coding errors in refugee interview transcripts correlate systematically with respondents' refugee status, gender, and education level—precisely the variables used as effect modifiers in downstream causal analysis. Any study using LLM-annotated text variables as moderators produces unreliable heterogeneity findings whenever annotation error rates differ across subgroups—and Ashwin et al. show this is the norm, not the exception.\\\\n\\\\n**Key anti-intuitive finding: global correction can actively worsen CATE estimates.** Consider a two-subgroup example. Subgroup A has high misclassification (25%) and large CATE (0.5 SD); Subgroup B has low misclassification (5%) and small CATE (0.1 SD). A global correction uses a pooled confusion matrix (~15% error), which under-corrects Subgroup A and over-corrects Subgroup B. The net effect: globally-corrected CATE estimates can have *larger* bias than uncorrected estimates. This is not an edge case—it occurs whenever the misclassification pattern and CATE structure are positively correlated, which empirical evidence suggests is common in practice.\\\\n\\\\n## Core Contributions\\\\n\\\\nThis paper makes four contributions:\\\\n\\\\n1. **Problem identification and formalization.** We identify and formalize measurement-error-induced CATE distortion—a new class of bias arising when LLM annotation errors in effect modifiers are differential across subgroups and correlated with the true heterogeneity structure. We show this is structurally distinct from: ATE-level debiasing (Mozer, arXiv:2603.19160; Egami et al., NeurIPS 2023 DSL; Zrnic & Candès, ICML 2024), CATE-to-GATE aggregation bias (Persson et al., arXiv:2602.20383, where bias originates from aggregation, not measurement error), and conditional inference with outcome prediction noise (Sui et al., arXiv:2603.05575 PPCI, which assumes the conditioning variable is correct). We prove that global correction can *increase* CATE bias relative to uncorrected estimates when misclassification and CATE heterogeneity are positively correlated.\\\\n\\\\n2. **Actionable diagnostic criterion (Bias Bound).** We derive a finite-sample bound: the bias of globally-corrected CATE estimates is proportional to the product of (a) misclassification heterogeneity across subgroups and (b) CATE heterogeneity across subgroups. This product yields a practical diagnostic: given pilot data, any researcher can compute this quantity *before* running full CATE analysis to determine whether global correction suffices or stratified correction is necessary. This diagnostic has standalone value independent of the EC-HTE framework—it applies to any CATE analysis using LLM-annotated effect modifiers. The bound implies that bias is worst when annotation is least accurate for subgroups where treatment effects are largest—empirically common (Ashwin et al., 2025).\\\\n\\\\n3. **EC-HTE: A three-stage correction framework** providing subgroup-specific misclassification correction, valid confidence intervals, and optimal annotation allocation (detailed below).\\\\n\\\\n4. **Empirical validation** via semi-synthetic benchmarks with controlled DGPs (including systematic variation of misclassification-CATE correlation direction) and a real-data misclassification pattern validation (Ashwin et al., 2025, Rohingya interview corpus).\\\\n\\\\n## Why Not Just Use Expert Labels?\\\\n\\\\nA natural objection: why not skip LLM annotation entirely and estimate CATEs using only expert-labeled data? The answer is a bias-variance tradeoff specific to CATE estimation. With a budget of ~2,000 expert labels distributed across k subgroups, each subgroup contains ~2,000/k observations. Honest causal forests (Wager & Athey, JASA 2018) split this further into estimation and splitting samples, leaving each cell with ~1,000/k observations—insufficient for detecting moderate heterogeneity when k ≥ 4.\\\\n\\\\nEC-HTE resolves this by using the full unlabeled corpus (potentially hundreds of thousands of LLM-annotated observations) for low-variance CATE estimation, with expert labels only for calibrating subgroup-specific misclassification. This extends the PPI/DSL paradigm—combining noisy large-scale with clean small-scale data—from ATE to CATE, where data demands make the combination even more critical.\\\\n\\\\n## Method: Three-Stage Framework\\\\n\\\\n**Stage 1: Hierarchical Bayesian Subgroup-Specific Misclassification Estimation.** For each effect-modifier subgroup g ∈ {1, …, k}, we estimate a confusion matrix C_g between LLM annotation and expert gold standard using a hierarchical Bayesian model with partial pooling. The hierarchy allows low-sample subgroups to borrow strength from the global structure while permitting genuine cross-subgroup variation. This addresses a key tension: per-subgroup independent estimation (high variance when subgroup expert-label counts are small) vs. single global estimation (biased when misclassification rates genuinely differ). For computational scalability in large-scale simulation studies, we use variational inference (VI) as the primary fitting method, with MCMC validation on representative configurations in the appendix.\\\\n\\\\n**Stage 2: Corrected CATE Estimation with Sandwich Variance Adjustment.** Corrected effect-modifier assignments are fed into an honest causal forest (Wager & Athey, JASA 2018). Because Stage 1 introduces nuisance parameter uncertainty, naive confidence intervals will under-cover. We derive a sandwich variance inflator propagating Stage 1 uncertainty into Stage 2 CIs, ensuring valid coverage. Bootstrap-based CIs serve as a robustness check.\\\\n\\\\n**Stage 3: Adaptive Expert Annotation Allocation.** Given a fixed expert budget B, we optimize allocation across subgroups by jointly minimizing misclassification estimation uncertainty and CATE estimation variance. The allocation criterion targets subgroups where the product of misclassification uncertainty and CATE magnitude is largest—precisely where annotation errors cause the most CATE distortion (as predicted by the bias bound).\\\\n\\\\n**Cold-start protocol.** Since Stage 3 requires initial estimates of both misclassification rates and CATE magnitudes, we employ a multi-batch protocol: (a) allocate 20–30% of B as a uniform pilot batch; (b) estimate initial confusion matrices and CATE values; (c) allocate remaining budget adaptively. We include pilot ratio sensitivity analysis (10%, 20%, 30%) in the experiments.\\\\n\\\\n## Related Work and Differentiation\\\\n\\\\n**Thread 1: LLM annotation debiasing (ATE-level).** DSL (Egami et al., NeurIPS 2023), PPI and its algebraic equivalence to survey-sampling difference estimators (Mozer, arXiv:2603.19160), active inference (Zrnic & Candès, ICML 2024), stratified PPI (StratPPI, Fisch et al., NeurIPS 2024), active multi-predictor PPI (AM-PPI, arXiv:2605.08429), and benchmarking thereof (Audinet de Pieuchon et al., EMNLP 2025). All locked to population-level estimands. Messing (arXiv:2604.11581) diagnoses hidden measurement error causing 40–60% CI under-coverage but does not extend to causal HTE correction.\\\\n\\\\n**Thread 2: HTE/CATE estimation methods.** Honest causal forests (Wager & Athey, JASA 2018), DR-learner, CATE-to-GATE aggregation bias correction (Persson et al., arXiv:2602.20383, shrinkage for aggregation-induced bias assuming clean covariates), and assumption-lean HTE detection under mismeasured modifiers (Boileau et al., arXiv:2512.03254, hypothesis testing for whether heterogeneity exists, not CATE estimation—complementary to EC-HTE). CATE evaluation standards established in \\\\\\\"Really Doing Great at Estimating CATE?\\\\\\\" (NeurIPS D&B 2021).\\\\n\\\\n**Thread 3: Conditional inference with ML predictions.** PPCI (Sui et al., arXiv:2603.05575) extends PPI to conditional functionals at fixed test points via kernel localization. Critical distinction: PPCI addresses outcome prediction noise at a correctly-specified conditioning point; EC-HTE addresses the situation where the conditioning variable (effect modifier) itself is misclassified. PPCI's localization anchors on correct covariate values—when the anchor itself is wrong (categorical misclassification), kernel localization cannot help.\\\\n\\\\n**Thread 4: Measurement error correction for ML-generated variables.** ForestIV (Bu et al., INFORMS JDS 2023) uses random forest tree tuples as instrumental variables, but requires IV exclusion restrictions and is limited to regression settings, not CATE with categorical effect modifiers. Jerzak et al. (arXiv:2509.12416, SRI framework) provide valid inference under noisy annotation but do not address effect modifier misclassification's impact on HTE. SIMEX handles continuous measurement error models but does not directly apply to categorical misclassification.\\\\n\\\\n**Thread 5: Causal inference with textual variables.** Feldman et al. (arXiv:2602.15730) address latent textual treatment estimation using SAE + residualization, assuming clean effect modifiers. Nwankwo et al. (arXiv:2502.10605, NeurIPS 2025 Workshop) optimize annotation allocation for doubly robust ATE with missing outcomes—different estimand (ATE vs. CATE), different error source (outcome missingness vs. effect modifier misclassification), different optimization landscape.\\\\n\\\\nEC-HTE sits at the intersection of Threads 1–4: correcting LLM misclassification specifically in effect modifiers for valid CATE estimation.\\\\n\\\\n## Validation Design\\\\n\\\\n### Semi-Synthetic Experiments\\\\n\\\\n**Corpus.** Political science text corpus with real-world linguistic variation (e.g., immigration framing data or partisan tweet datasets with known ideological annotations).\\\\n\\\\n**DGP Matrix.** Core factors:\\\\n- Misclassification severity: high (25–30%) vs. low (5–10%)\\\\n- CATE heterogeneity magnitude: large (>0.3 SD) vs. small (<0.1 SD)\\\\n- Subgroup count: k=3 vs. k=6\\\\n- **Misclassification-CATE correlation direction**: positive (high-error subgroups have high CATE, worst-case) vs. negative (high-error subgroups have low CATE, best-case)\\\\n\\\\nSelective design: 12–14 configurations covering all worst-case/best-case combinations for the key factors, rather than full 2⁴=16 factorial.\\\\n\\\\nTreatment assignment T ~ Bernoulli(0.5); potential outcomes Y(1), Y(0) generated with known ground-truth CATE τ(x) varying by subgroup.\\\\n\\\\n**Replications.** ≥ 200 per configuration.\\\\n\\\\n**Sample sizes.** N ∈ {2000, 5000, 10000}.\\\\n\\\\n**Expert label budget.** B ∈ {100, 500, 1000, 2000} to produce budget vs. performance curves. All methods compared under identical total budget.\\\\n\\\\n**LLMs.** Three annotators: GPT-4.1 (proprietary frontier), Qwen 3.5 (open-source large), Llama 3.3 (open-source, different family). Fourth LLM as appendix robustness check.\\\\n\\\\n### Comparison Methods (all under fixed expert annotation budget B)\\\\n\\\\n1. **Uncorrected**: LLM annotations used directly as effect modifiers in causal forest.\\\\n2. **Globally-corrected**: Single confusion matrix → corrected annotations → causal forest.\\\\n3. **Arm-specific (Mozer-style)**: Separate confusion matrices for treatment/control arms → causal forest.\\\\n4. **SIMEX + causal forest**: SIMEX-based measurement error correction → causal forest.\\\\n5. **Calibration-only + causal forest**: Platt scaling / temperature scaling → calibrated probabilities as soft effect modifiers → causal forest.\\\\n6. **EC-HTE (full)**: Hierarchical Bayesian subgroup-specific correction → sandwich-adjusted causal forest → adaptive allocation.\\\\n\\\\n### Evaluation Metrics\\\\n\\\\n- **PEHE**: √E[(τ̂(x) − τ(x))²], overall and per-subgroup.\\\\n- **Subgroup CATE bias**: |E[τ̂_g] − τ_g| for each subgroup g.\\\\n- **CI empirical coverage**: Fraction of replications where true CATE falls within 95% CI (target: 0.95).\\\\n- **CI width**: Efficiency measure at fixed coverage.\\\\n- **GATE RMSE**: RMSE of group average treatment effect estimates.\\\\n- **Bound tightness**: Observed bias vs. theoretical bound prediction.\\\\n\\\\n### Ablation Studies\\\\n\\\\n**Stage 1 ablation (partial pooling):**\\\\n- (a) Hierarchical Bayesian with VI (partial pooling)\\\\n- (b) Per-subgroup independent confusion matrices (no pooling)\\\\n- (c) Single global confusion matrix (full pooling)\\\\n- (d) Prior sensitivity: 2–3 prior settings (weakly informative, moderately informative, diffuse) on 1–2 representative DGP configurations\\\\n\\\\n**Stage 2 ablation (variance adjustment):**\\\\n- (a) Sandwich variance-adjusted CIs\\\\n- (b) Bootstrap-based CIs\\\\n- (c) Naive CIs (no adjustment)\\\\n→ Compare empirical coverage rates.\\\\n\\\\n**Stage 3 ablation (allocation strategy):**\\\\n- (a) Joint criterion (misclassification uncertainty × CATE magnitude)\\\\n- (b) Misclassification-uncertainty-only allocation\\\\n- (c) CATE-magnitude-only allocation\\\\n- (d) Uniform allocation\\\\n- (e) Pilot ratio sensitivity: 10%, 20%, 30% of B as uniform pilot batch\\\\n→ Compare PEHE at fixed total budget B.\\\\n\\\\n**Diagnostic validation:** Systematically vary misclassification heterogeneity and CATE heterogeneity (including correlation direction); produce heatmap of EC-HTE improvement over global correction vs. (product of heterogeneity measures). Verify that the theoretical bound predicts when global correction fails and when it suffices. Specifically demonstrate that global correction is worse than uncorrected in positive-correlation configurations.\\\\n\\\\n**CATE estimator robustness (appendix):** In 1–2 worst-case configurations, replace causal forest with DR-learner to verify EC-HTE's correction generalizes beyond a single CATE estimator.\\\\n\\\\n### Real-Data Application (Ashwin et al., 2025)\\\\n\\\\n**Dataset.** Rohingya refugee interview transcripts (Ashwin et al., Sociological Methods & Research 2025). This dataset's primary role is validating the premise of EC-HTE—that LLM misclassification is differential—rather than evaluating CATE estimation accuracy (the dataset lacks a natural causal structure).\\\\n\\\\n**Validation goals:**\\\\n1. **Differential misclassification pattern confirmation**: Quantify and visualize how LLM error rates vary across subgroups defined by refugee status, gender, education.\\\\n2. **Leave-expert-out calibration test**: Treat full human labels as ground truth, subsample B expert labels, evaluate whether EC-HTE's hierarchical confusion matrix estimates recover the true subgroup-specific error patterns better than global estimation.\\\\n3. **Diagnostic criterion demonstration**: Compute the misclassification-heterogeneity × CATE-heterogeneity product on this dataset (constructing a plausible causal question from available variables) to demonstrate the diagnostic's operability.\\\\n4. **Budget curve**: Accuracy of confusion matrix recovery vs. expert label budget B.\\\\n\\\\nCATE estimation accuracy is rigorously evaluated in the semi-synthetic experiments where ground-truth CATE is known.\\\\n\\\\n## Scope and Limitations\\\\n\\\\nEC-HTE targets **categorical effect modifiers** (stance, topic, sentiment, entity type, etc.)—the dominant use case when LLM annotations serve as moderators in computational social science. When the effect modifier is a continuous variable that has been discretized (binned), misclassification includes both LLM errors and discretization error; the current framework does not disentangle these sources. Extension to continuous effect modifiers with measurement error (where SIMEX-type approaches may be more natural) is future work.\\\\n\\\\n## Broader Applicability\\\\n\\\\nWhile our validation focuses on CSS, the same problem structure arises whenever ML-predicted categorical variables serve as effect modifiers: in medical research (ML-classified tumor subtypes as moderators of drug efficacy), education (NLP-coded classroom behaviors moderating intervention effects), and policy evaluation (automated classification of administrative characteristics). EC-HTE's framework and diagnostic criterion apply directly to these settings.\\\\n\\\\n## Expected Contributions\\\\n\\\\nEC-HTE provides (1) the first formal identification of measurement-error-induced CATE distortion in LLM-annotated pipelines, including the proof that global correction can worsen estimates; (2) an actionable diagnostic (the misclassification-heterogeneity × CATE-heterogeneity product) with standalone value for any CATE analysis; (3) a practical three-stage correction framework with valid inference; and (4) comprehensive empirical validation. The framework serves any study using LLM-annotated categorical text variables as effect modifiers in causal troubleshooting\\\\n- best-practice\\\\nversion: 72\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n# ML 实验避坑指南\\\\n\\\\n本指南由各项目 Director 持续维护，记录跨项目通用的实验教训。每条只保留问题模式和规则，不含项目/实验特定信息。\\\\n\\\\n## Eval 规范\\\\n### 必须全量全类别 eval，partial 数据严禁混用\\\\n- **问题模式**: 只用部分类别/样本做 mid-eval，与全量 baseline 比较导致错误决策；或 partial eval 报告的指标与全量 eval 结果混用，误判趋势\\\\n- **规则**: 所有 eval 必须覆盖完整测试集；partial eval 必须标注 `PARTIAL: X/Y samples`，禁止与全量结果直接比较；partial 和全量数据必须分开记录和比较，partial 数据禁止用于最终决策\\\\n\\\\n### 长训练必须有 mid-training eval + 持久化\\\\n- **问题模式**: 训练 >3000 步无中间 eval，复现失败时无同步点对照，根因诊断退化为猜测\\\\n- **规则**: 任何长训练（>3000 steps）必须每 1000 step 至少一次 val eval；eval 数据保留到 JSON/CSV（不仅是日志），确保复现实验时有逐 step 对照基线\\\\n\\\\n### 相关性评估必须用全量数据或 bootstrap CI\\\\n- **问题模式**: 用少量随机采样（如 200 对）计算 Spearman/Pearson 相关系数，因采样方差导致 ρ 被严重高估（实测案例：200 对 ρ=0.57，全量 8840 对 ρ=0.31，高估近一倍），基于此做出错误的 PROCEED 决策\\\\n- **规则**: 相关性评估必须用全量数据；若因计算成本必须采样，使用分层抽样 + bootstrap CI（≥1000 次重采样）报告置信区间，不能用点估计做 go/no-go 决策\\\\n\\\\n### Retrieval 评估：metric 定义 + sanity check\\\\n- **问题模式**: (1) 引用 SOTA 数字时混淆 R@1/R@10/R_subset@K 或不同 candidate pool 规模，导致误判自己的结果异常；(2) eval 脚本的 candidate pool 构造错误（target 未排除、query 字段错用、split 泄漏）导致虚高指标\\\\n- **规则**: 引用 SOTA 数字时必须带 metric 名 + candidate pool 规模 + 数据集名；评估前先用 5-10 条 case 比对论文公开数字（同一 metric 同一 pool），差距 >2x 才需要停下排查\\\\n\\\\n### Decoder-only 模型批量 eval 必须用 left-padding\\\\n- **问题模式**: 批量推理/eval 时 tokenizer 使用默认 right-padding，decoder-only 架构下 PAD token 出现在输入末尾，破坏 causal attention mask，系统性降低生成质量。实测导致 eval 指标被低估 5-8pp，且 DDP multi-GPU eval 放大此效应（更大 batch = 更多 padding）\\\\n- **规则**: 任何 decoder-only 模型（GPT、LLaMA、Qwen 等）的批量生成/eval 前必须设置 `tokenizer.padding_side = 'left'`；运行时如果出现 `right-padding was detected` 警告必须立即修复，不能忽略\\\\n\\\\n## Checkpoint 管理\\\\n### save_total_limit + save_best_model\\\\n- **问题模式**: save_total_limit 过小，训练继续运行后最优 checkpoint 被自动删除，增益全部丧失\\\\n- **规则**: save_total_limit ≥ 50；必须配置 save_best_model 将最优 checkpoint 备份到独立目录（永不自动删除）；配置 early_stopping_patience\\\\n\\\\n## 进程管理\\\\n### Kill 训练进程必须杀整个进程组\\\\n- **问题模式**: (1) kill 主进程后，accelerate/DDP 的 worker 子进程继续运行，训练实际未停止；(2) tmux/nohup 启动的训练中，kill bash 包裹进程（tmux → bash PID）但 SIGKILL 未传递给 python 子进程，python 继续占 GPU 成为僵尸进程，而监控误报 GPU 空闲\\\\n- **规则**: kill 时必须用 `kill -- -<pgid>` 杀整个进程组，或 `kill $(pgrep -P $PID)` 先杀子进程再杀父进程。kill 后必须 `nvidia-smi` 确认目标 GPU 上无残留进程。绝不能只 kill tmux/bash 父 PID 就假设训练已停止\\\\n\\\\n### 标记实验 DONE 时必须同步 kill 进程\\\\n- **问题模式**: Agent 在 registry 中标记实验 DONE（success/failed）但未实际 kill 训练进程，进程继续占用 GPU 跑废模型（如崩溃后 1% accuracy），report.md 误报\\\\\\\"GPU 空闲\\\\\\\"而实际被僵尸进程占满，排队实验无法启动\\\\n- **规则**: 标记实验 DONE 的操作必须原子化：(1) kill 进程 (2) nvidia-smi 确认 GPU 释放 (3) 更新 registry。三步全做完才算 DONE。绝不接受\\\\\\\"先标 DONE 再说\\\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n### 训练脚本必须有 collapse 早停机制\\\\n- **问题模式**: 训练过程中 val_acc 崩溃（如从 50%+ 跌到 1%），但脚本无检测逻辑，继续运行数小时浪费 GPU，直到人工发现才 kill\\\\n- **规则**: 训练脚本必须实现 collapse 检测：val_acc 相对历史最高值下降超过 30pp 且连续 3 个 eval 不恢复则自动终止训练，退出码设为非零以便监控系统识别\\\\n\\\\n### 实验状态检测禁止依赖 tmux session 状态，必须用 ps -p PID\\\\n- **问题模式**: Agent 通过 tmux session 是否存在来判断训练进程是否仍在运行。tmux session 可因多种原因消失（server 崩溃、手动 kill-session、session 超时清理）而训练 python 进程仍在正常运行。反复导致正在跑的实验被误标为 failed/killed，registry 与实际状态严重不一致，report.md 误报 GPU 空闲\\\\n- **规则**: 检测实验是否仍在运行时，必须用 `ps -p <PID> -o pid=` 直接查进程存活状态，辅以 `nvidia-smi` 确认 GPU 占用。禁止以 tmux session 存在与否作为进程存活的判断依据。状态检测与操作前验证同等重要——错误的状态检测会级联导致错误的 registry 更新、错误的资源报告、错误的实验调度\\\\n\\\\n### 操作进程前必须 SSH 验证实际状态\\\\n- **问题模式**: (1) 提交重跑时未验证旧进程是否已死、目标 bias，甚至比不纠偏更差。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 当前主线 Hypothesis\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nH1: 在 misclassification rate 与真实 subgroup CATE magnitude 正相关的 DGP 中，全局 confusion-matrix correction 会 under-correct 高误差/高效应 Memory\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 项目定位\\\\\\\\nEC-HTE 研究目标是纠正 LLM 生成的分类 effect modifier 中的差异性误分类对 CATE/HTE 估计造成的结构性偏差。首要可证伪机制是：当 subgroup misclassification rate 与真实 subgroup CATE magnitude 正相关时，单一全局 confusion-matrix correction 会系统性 under-correct 高误差/高效应 subgroup，并 over-correct 低误差/低效应 subgroup，因此可能比 uncorrected 更差。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 执行约束\\\\\\\\n`PROJECT_BRIEF.md` 同步存在于本项目 `docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md`。项目配置绑定 `seetacloud-38274/root/cuda:0`；2026-05-31 Director 已确认 `list_available_gpus` 可见该 GPU，型号为 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition，显存约 98GB。GPU 实验仍必须只使用白名单 `cuda:0`，并在启动前记录 server、GPU 型号、driver、命令、数据路径与 seed。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 领域参考\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### HTE/CATE 标准评测协议\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- Honest causal forest: Wager & Athey (JASA 2018; arXiv:1510.04342, https://arxiv.org/abs/1510.04342; DOI page https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/01621459.2017.1319839) 给出用于 CATE/HTE 的 causal forest 和推断框架；honesty/sample splitting 是其核心推断条件。EC-HTE 的 causal-forest baseline 应固定 honesty 开启，并报告 CI coverage 与 CI width，避免只报点估计误差。\\\\\\\\n- GRF implementation reference: `grf::causal_forest` 文档说明 causal forest 用于估计 tau(X)，并提示 accurate confidence intervals 通常需要比 prediction 更多 trees；同时把 honesty 定义为 subsample splitting。来源：https://grf-labs.github.io/grf/reference/causal_forest.html。实现时需记录 `num.trees`、`honesty`、`honesty.fraction`、seed、train/test split。\\\\\\\\n- CATE benchmark caution: Curth, Svensson, Weatherall & van der Schaar, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Really Doing Great at Estimating CATE?\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" NeurIPS D&B 2021（https://openreview.net/forum?id=FQLzQqGEAH；PDF https://datasets-benchmarks-proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2021/file/2a79ea27c279e471f4d180b08d62b00a-Paper-round2.pdf）指出常见 semi-synthetic CATE benchmark 和单一 metric 可能偏向特定算法，因此 EC-HTE 必须同时报告 pointwise、group-level 和 inference metrics，而不是只报告 PEHE。\\\\\\\\n- PEHE / root-PEHE: Shalit, Johansson & Sontag, ICML 2017（https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/shalit17a.html；arXiv:1606.03976）沿用 ITE/CATE 估计误差评测；本项目定义为 `sqrt(mean_i((tau_hat_i - tau_i)^2))`，仅用于 synthetic/semi-synthetic 中 ground-truth tau_i 已知的设置。项目 brief 已列 PEHE 为主指标。\\\\\\\\n- GATE: Group Average Treatment Effect 是预先定义 subgroup 内的平均处理效应，DoubleML 文档定义为 `E[Y(1)-Y(0)|G=1]`（https://docs.doubleml.org/tutorial/stable/lectures/L3/heterogeneity.html）；Stata 19 CATE 文档也把 GATE/GATES 作为 IATE/CATE 的 group-level summaries（https://www.stata.com/stata19/cate/）。本项目 GATE RMSE 定义为 `sqrt(mean_g((tau_hat_g - tau_g)^2))`，用于 k 个真实 subgroup CATE 已知的 simulation。\\\\\\\\n- Replication / split reporting: 项目 brief 明确半合成实验使用 `R >= 200` replications、`N in {2000, 5000, 10000}`、expert budget `B in {100, 500, 1000, 2000}`、subgroup count `k in {3, 6}`、treatment assignment `T ~ Bernoulli(0.5)`。这些是首批实验的默认规模来源；任何缩小版只能标为 smoke/MVP，不写成正式结论。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### LLM annotation debiasing 与适用边界\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- PPI: Angelopoulos, Bates, Fannjiang, Jordan & Zrnic, Science 2023 / arXiv:2301.09633（https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.09633；Science DOI https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adi6000）将少量 gold labels 与大量 ML predictions 结合，为 means、quantiles、linear/logistic regression coefficients 等 population parameters 构造有效 CI。本项目可把 PPI 作为 ATE / population regression coefficient correction baseline；不能直接声称它修正 misclassified categorical effect modifier 下的 subgroup CATE，除非把每个 subgroup estimand 单独建模并处理 subgroup membership error。\\\\\\\\n- DSL: Egami, Hinck, Stewart & Wei, NeurIPS 2023 / arXiv:2306.04746（https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.04746）针对 CSS 中 LLM/surrogate labels 的 downstream statistical analysis，使用 gold-standard labels 与 controlled sampling probability 来获得 asymptotic unbiasedness 和 uncertainty quantification。适合作为 downstream regression/ATE-style estimand 的 debiasing baseline；不自动解决 effect modifier 本身被错分导致的 CATE conditioning error。\\\\\\\\n- DSL/PPI finite-sample benchmark: Audinet de Pieuchon et al., EMNLP 2025（ACL Anthology https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.1000/；arXiv:2506.09627）比较 DSL 与 PPI 在有限 expert labels 下的 LLM-based parameter estimate debiasing；结论范围是 population parameters / regression coefficients / causal effects 的 debiasing，不是 CATE modifier misclassification correction。可引用为为什么首批实验需要固定 expert budget curves。\\\\\\\\n- StratPPI: Fisch et al., NeurIPS 2024（https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/c9fcd02e6445c7dfbad6986abee53d0d-Abstract-Conference.html；arXiv:2406.04291）通过 stratified sampling 缩窄 PPI CI，尤其当 autorater performance across conditional distributions varies。EC-HTE 可把 StratPPI 作为 ATE/population mean 的 stratified correction baseline，或作为 expert allocation 思路来源；不能把它当成 categorical modifier confusion-matrix correction，除非 correction estimand 明确改成每个 subgroup 的 gold-label estimand。\\\\\\\\n- Active Statistical Inference / AM-PPI: Zrnic & Candès, ICML 2024 Active Statistical Inference（https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.03208；ICML page https://icml.cc/virtual/2024/poster/34504）用 model uncertainty 主动选择 gold labels 并构造有效 CI；Brawand et al., AM-PPI arXiv:2605.08429（https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08429）扩展为多 predictor、per-instance routing、residual uncertainty sampling。可作为 Stage 3 allocation baseline/灵感；其原始目标是 population mean monitoring/valid CI，不直接修 CATE conditioning variable 的 misclassification。\\\\\\\\n- Mozer difference-estimator view: Mozer, arXiv:2603.19160（https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19160）指出 PPI mean estimator 等价于 survey sampling difference estimator，并讨论 differential prediction error for subgroup estimands such as ATE。项目中的 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"arm-specific rectifier\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" baseline 应仅实现为 treatment/control arm 内各自估计 LLM-vs-expert residual/confusion correction，然后估计 ATE/GATE；它仍然是 arm-level/population-level rectification，不能代替 subgroup-specific modifier confusion correction。\\\\\\\\n- Ashwin real-data motivation: Ashwin, Chhabra & Rao, Sociological Methods & Research 2025, DOI 10.1177/00491241251338246（publisher page https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/00491241251338246；Maastricht record https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/using-large-language-models-for-qualitative-analysis-can-introduc-2/）用 Rohingya/Bengali host interviews 说明 LLM coding errors are not random with respect to respondent characteristics。World Bank summary explicitly names refugee status, gender, education as non-random error correlates（https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099348304162431121/pdf/IDU1271bc2541c5e8144f51b8cc1be231f985cc6.pdf）。本项目 real-data validation 只用于验证 differential misclassification pattern，不用于声称真实 CATE accuracy。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Measurement error / categorical misclassification correction baselines\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- Global confusion matrix correction: 从 expert validation subset 估计单一 `P(Z_hat | Z)` 或 inverse matrix，把所有 subgroup 共用同一 misclassification mechanism。来源对应 epidemiology 中 matrix / inverse matrix correction for misclassification；见 Lyles et al. extended matrix/inverse matrix method with internal validation data（PMC https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4382468/）。本项目必须报告当 subgroup-specific error differs 时 global correction 的 under/over-correction。\\\\\\\\n- Per-subgroup confusion matrix correction: 在每个 true or pilot-estimated subgroup g 内估计 `C_g = P(Z_hat | Z, g)`，再做 correction。该 baseline 是 EC-HTE 的 non-pooled comparator；高方差风险来自每组 expert labels 少。来源是同一 validation-data misclassification framework；partial pooling 是本项目新增稳定化层，不能把 independent per-subgroup correction 写成已有 EC-HTE 结果。\\\\\\\\n- Arm-specific correction: treatment/control arm 内分别估计 confusion/residual correction，模拟 Mozer/PPI arm-level rectifier 对 ATE 的处理。适用 ATE 或 arm-specific mean outcome/label correction；不能直接修正 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"which subgroup is the unit conditioned on\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" 的 modifier misclassification，除非同时对 subgroup-specific `C_{g,t}` 做建模。\\\\\\\\n- SIMEX categorical approximation: Kuchenhoff, Mwalili & Lesaffre, Biometrics 2006（PubMed https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16542233/）把 SIMEX 扩展到 discrete covariate/response misclassification，通过 transition matrix Pi 增加误分类并外推到无误分类。EC-HTE 可实现为 categorical transition-matrix SIMEX + causal forest baseline；必须标记为近似 baseline，因为项目目标变量是 categorical effect modifier，而 classic SIMEX 更自然地服务 regression parameter correction。\\\\\\\\n- Calibration/probability modifier baseline: 用 expert validation subset 做 Platt scaling / temperature scaling 或 Dirichlet/multinomial calibration，把 LLM hard label 改成 calibrated class probabilities，再作为 soft modifier features 输入 CATE estimator。该实现只校准 predicted probabilities；如果 downstream CATE 仍按 hard subgroup 分层，它不会消除 subgroup membership error。概率校准作为一般 ML practice 可参考 Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana, ICML 2005（https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1102351.1102430），但 EC-HTE 需在 artifact 中记录 calibration loss 和 subgroup confusion recovery，而非只报 predictive accuracy。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 首批实验协议\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### over-correct 低误差/低效应 subgroup，因此可能比 uncorrected 更差。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 执行约束\\\\\\\\n`PROJECT_BRIEF.md` 同步存在于本项目 `docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md`。项目配置绑定 `seetacloud-38274/root/cuda:0`；2026-05-31 Director 已确认 领域参考\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### HTE/CATE 标准评测协议\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- Honest causal forest: Wager & Athey (JASA 2018; arXiv:1510.04342, https://arxiv.org/abs/1510.04342; DOI page https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/01621459.2017.1319839) 给出用于 CATE/HTE 的 causal forest 和推断框架；honesty/sample splitting 是其核心推断条件。EC-HTE 的 causal-forest baseline 应固定 honesty 开启，并报告 CI coverage 与 CI width，避免只报点估计误差。\\\\\\\\n- GRF implementation reference: `grf::causal_forest` 文档说明 causal forest 用于估计 tau(X)，并提示 accurate confidence intervals 通常需要比 prediction 更多 trees；同时把 honesty 定义为 subsample splitting。来源：https://grf-labs.github.io/grf/reference/causal_forest.html。实现时需记录 `num.trees`、`honesty`、`honesty.fraction`、seed、train/test split。\\\\\\\\n- CATE benchmark caution: Curth, Svensson, Weatherall & van der Schaar, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Really Doing Great at Estimating CATE?\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" NeurIPS D&B 2021（https://openreview.net/forum?id=FQLzQqGEAH；PDF https://datasets-benchmarks-proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2021/file/2a79ea27c279e471f4d180b08d62b00a-Paper-round2.pdf）指出常见 semi-synthetic CATE benchmark 和单一 metric 可能偏向特定算法，因此 EC-HTE 必须同时报告 pointwise、group-level 和 inference metrics，而不是只报告 PEHE。\\\\\\\\n- PEHE / root-PEHE: Shalit, Johansson & Sontag, ICML 2017（https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/shalit17a.html；arXiv:1606.03976）沿用 ITE/CATE 估计误差评测；本项目定义为 `sqrt(mean_i((tau_hat_i - tau_i)^2))`，仅用于 synthetic/semi-synthetic 中 ground-truth tau_i 已知的设置。项目 brief 已列 PEHE 为主指标。\\\\\\\\n- GATE: Group Average Treatment Effect 是预先定义 subgroup 内的平均处理效应，DoubleML 文档定义为 `E[Y(1)-Y(0)|G=1]`（https://docs.doubleml.org/tutorial/stable/lectures/L3/heterogeneity.html）；Stata 19 CATE 文档也把 GATE/GATES 作为 IATE/CATE 的 group-level summaries（https://www.stata.com/stata19/cate/）。本项目 GATE RMSE 定义为 `sqrt(mean_g((tau_hat_g - tau_g)^2))`，用于 k 个真实 subgroup CATE 已知的 simulation。\\\\\\\\n- Replication / split reporting: 项目 brief 明确半合成实验使用 `R >= 200` replications、`N in {2000, 5000, 10000}`、expert budget `B in {100, 500, 1000, 2000}`、subgroup count `k in {3, 6}`、treatment assignment `T ~ Bernoulli(0.5)`。这些是首批实验的默认规模来源；任何缩小版只能标为 smoke/MVP，不写成正式结论。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### LLM annotation debiasing 与适用边界\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- PPI: Angelopoulos, Bates, Fannjiang, Jordan & Zrnic, Science 2023 / arXiv:2301.09633（https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.09633；Science DOI https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adi6000）将少量 gold labels 与大量 ML predictions 结合，为 means、quantiles、linear/logistic regression coefficients 等 population parameters 构造有效 CI。本项目可把 PPI 作为 ATE / population regression coefficient correction baseline；不能直接声称它修正 misclassified categorical effect modifier 下的 subgroup CATE，除非把每个 subgroup estimand 单独建模并处理 subgroup membership error。\\\\\\\\n- DSL: Egami, Hinck, Stewart & Wei, NeurIPS 2023 / arXiv:2306.04746（https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.04746）针对 CSS 中 LLM/surrogate labels 的 downstream statistical analysis，使用 gold-standard labels 与 controlled sampling probability 来获得 asymptotic unbiasedness 和 uncertainty quantification。适合作为 downstream regression/ATE-style estimand 的 debiasing baseline；不自动解决 effect modifier 本身被错分导致的 CATE conditioning error。\\\\\\\\n- DSL/PPI finite-sample benchmark: Audinet de Pieuchon et al., EMNLP 2025（ACL Anthology https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.1000/；arXiv:2506.09627）比较 DSL 与 PPI 在有限 expert labels 下的 LLM-based parameter estimate debiasing；结论范围是 population parameters / regression coefficients / causal effects 的 debiasing，不是 CATE modifier misclassification correction。可引用为为什么首批实验需要固定 expert budget curves。\\\\\\\\n- StratPPI: Fisch et al., NeurIPS 2024（https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/c9fcd02e6445c7dfbad6986abee53d0d-Abstract-Conference.html；arXiv:2406.04291）通过 stratified sampling 缩窄 PPI CI，尤其当 autorater performance across conditional distributions varies。EC-HTE 可把 StratPPI 作为 ATE/population mean 的 stratified correction baseline，或作为 expert allocation 思路来源；不能把它当成 categorical modifier confusion-matrix correction，除非 correction estimand 明确改成每个 subgroup 的 gold-label estimand。\\\\\\\\n- Active Statistical Inference / AM-PPI: Zrnic & Candès, ICML 2024 Active Statistical Inference（https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.03208；ICML page https://icml.cc/virtual/2024/poster/34504）用 model uncertainty 主动选择 gold labels 并构造有效 CI；Brawand et al., AM-PPI arXiv:2605.08429（https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08429）扩展为多 predictor、per-instance routing、residual uncertainty sampling。可作为 Stage 3 allocation baseline/灵感；其原始目标是 population mean monitoring/valid CI，不直接修 CATE conditioning variable 的 misclassification。\\\\\\\\n- Mozer difference-estimator view: Mozer, arXiv:2603.19160（https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19160）指出 PPI mean estimator 等价于 survey sampling difference estimator，并讨论 differential prediction error for subgroup estimands such as ATE。项目中的 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"arm-specific rectifier\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" baseline 应仅实现为 treatment/control arm 内各自估计 LLM-vs-expert residual/confusion correction，然后估计 ATE/GATE；它仍然是 arm-level/population-level rectification，不能代替 subgroup-specific modifier confusion correction。\\\\\\\\n- Ashwin real-data motivation: Ashwin, Chhabra & Rao, Sociological Methods & Research 2025, DOI 10.1177/00491241251338246（publisher page https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/00491241251338246；Maastricht record https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/using-large-language-models-for-qualitative-analysis-can-introduc-2/）用 Rohingya/Bengali host interviews 说明 LLM coding errors are not random with respect to respondent characteristics。World Bank summary explicitly names refugee status, gender, education as non-random error correlates（https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099348304162431121/pdf/IDU1271bc2541c5e8144f51b8cc1be231f985cc6.pdf）。本项目 real-data validation 只用于验证 differential misclassification pattern，不用于声称真实 CATE accuracy。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Measurement error / categorical misclassification correction baselines\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- Global confusion matrix correction: 从 expert validation subset 估计单一 `P(Z_hat | Z)` 或 inverse matrix，把所有 subgroup 共用同一 misclassification mechanism。来源对应 epidemiology 中 matrix / inverse matrix correction for misclassification；见 Lyles et al. extended matrix/inverse matrix method with internal validation data（PMC https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4382468/）。本项目必须报告当 subgroup-specific error differs 时 global correction 的 under/over-correction。\\\\\\\\n- Per-subgroup confusion matrix correction: 在每个 true or pilot-estimated subgroup g 内估计 `C_g = P(Z_hat | Z, g)`，再做 correction。该 baseline 是 EC-HTE 的 non-pooled comparator；高方差风险来自每组 expert labels 少。来源是同一 validation-data misclassification framework；partial pooling 是本项目新增稳定化层，不能把 independent per-subgroup correction 写成已有 EC-HTE 结果。\\\\\\\\n- Arm-specific correction: treatment/control arm 内分别估计 confusion/residual correction，模拟 Mozer/PPI arm-level rectifier 对 ATE 的处理。适用 ATE 或 arm-specific mean outcome/label correction；不能直接修正 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"which subgroup is the unit conditioned on\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" 的 modifier misclassification，除非同时对 subgroup-specific `C_{g,t}` 做建模。\\\\\\\\n- SIMEX categorical approximation: Kuchenhoff, Mwalili & Lesaffre, Biometrics 2006（PubMed https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16542233/）把 SIMEX 扩展到 discrete covariate/response misclassification，通过 transition matrix Pi 增加误分类并外推到无误分类。EC-HTE 可实现为 categorical transition-matrix SIMEX + causal forest baseline；必须标记为近似 baseline，因为项目目标变量是 categorical effect modifier，而 classic SIMEX 更自然地服务 regression parameter correction。\\\\\\\\n- Calibration/probability modifier baseline: 用 expert validation subset 做 Platt scaling / temperature scaling 或 Dirichlet/multinomial calibration，把 LLM hard label 改成 calibrated class probabilities，再作为 soft modifier features 输入 CATE estimator。该实现只校准 predicted probabilities；如果 downstream CATE 仍按 hard subgroup 分层，它不会消除 subgroup membership error。概率校准作为一般 ML practice 可参考 Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana, ICML 2005（https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1102351.1102430），但 EC-HTE 需在 artifact 中记录 calibration loss 和 subgroup confusion recovery，而非只报 predictive accuracy。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 首批实验协议\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n###
